title: Pork Carnitas Tacos
description: A Mexican-inspired recipe featuring slow-cooked pork in a spicy tomato-based sauce, served in crispy buns.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the pork and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chouriço, hot sauce, and enough water to cover the pork.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the pork for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and easily shredded.
Warm the buns on a baking sheet in the oven.
Shred the pork with two forks and serve in the buns.
Garnish with cilantro, onion, and a slice of lime.
